# glpi_software_version (Resource)

GLPI software version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glpi_software" "editor" {
  name = "Editor"
}

resource "glpi_software_version" "v2" {
  name        = "2.0"
  software_id = glpi_software.editor.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the item.
- `software_id` (Number) ID of the software.

### Optional

- `architecture` (String) Architecture, such as x64.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `operating_system_id` (Number) ID of the operating system.
- `state_id` (Number) ID of the status.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by GLPI numeric ID.
terraform import glpi_software_version.example 42
```
